Verified Summary of University Conquests (2023 – 2026)

Across 13 Universities, Research Institutes & Clinical Centers, Bao Khoa Ngo has completed major conquered campaigns at VSSM, UAF (2024–2025 Fish Waste Composting), HCMUTE (2025–2026 Liminal Space RCT), IU VNU-HCM (SSC 2025 & 2026), HCMUS & Stem Cell Institute, HUIT, UEF, and SISEP, while actively besieging ongoing campaigns at HCMUT (Koji–SCOBY Bio-Leather), UAF (GeriGreen Cellugel Phase II), HCMUTE (SOMRA Sleep IoT Phase II), and Vinh University Journal of Science, alongside short-term field expeditions at Cho Ray Hospital and RMIT University Vietnam.
